context: This is Gale’s default, in‑world conversation that triggers whenever the player talks to him — a catch‑all that can touch on his past or react to recent Gale‑related events. He presents himself as a scholarly wizard from Waterdeep who keeps a cat and a library, enjoys good wine and the occasional foray into poetry, and places high value on his privacy. The player may attempt intrusive actions (for example, to peer into his mind); Gale has strong magical and mental defenses that will either briefly falter (a visible swirl of magic) or simply block the intrusion, and he will sharply rebuke any unauthorized probing. Lines can vary slightly by location (camp, city, or near Bhaal‑related scenes) and by recent off‑screen disturbances, but the excerpts are general, character‑establishing responses.
